title: focuser_primaluce sends WiFi SSIDs and passwords into the JSON request without escaping
summary: X_WIFI_AP and X_WIFI_STA insert the client's SSID and password into the request string as is (primalucelib_set_access_point_credentials / _set_station_credentials, formerly inline in the driver). A value containing a double quote or backslash produces an invalid request, which the controller refuses or misreads; the stored-position names already refuse these characters. Found by source audit during the protocol library extraction, which preserved the behaviour on purpose. Next action: a focuser_primaluce task that escapes or refuses such values in the library, with unit and simulator regression tests and a driver version bump.
